# Orchestrator 0226 (#966): three chained tasks

Iteration 0225 went well. #963 finished #958's verifier checks on `task/958` in 17 turns. It was merged (78ecbc3d), passed verification and was accepted. Review #964 (snapshot `.github/loop/data/session-reports/964/0c9220b7...json`) was CLEAR for R13a, #954 f2, #954 f4 and the new verifier checks, with `rejected_count` 64. It left three non-blocking residuals (f1-f3) and allowed UF-G to be ordered.

All three tasks touch `current-pins.json`, so they run one after another rather than in parallel:
1. `lineage-complete-0226` (benchmark/default/high, 60 min/40 turns): fixes #964 findings 1-3. It adds the consumer-completeness check plus candidate-0043 for artifact-0087, enforces `variant_member_artifacts` and the source line anchor, adds lineage-map-group/tasks mutations, updates the README count and re-pins.
2. `ufg-0226` (benchmark/default/high, 50/35, blocked_by 1): R13b. `benchmark/writing/verification.json` records the current verifier sha256 and the stdout hash of a real run, and every map that lists it is re-pinned.
3. `ufg-review-0226` (reviewer/default/high, 50/40, blocked_by 2): changed-scope review with a verdict for each of f1, f2, f3 and R13b. Its artifact is `ufg-review-0226.md`.

Expected gain: all UF rows from #938 and the #954/#964 residuals closed. If the review is CLEAR, the next shaper orders the whole-method re-review of the changed #938 rows. If it is NOT-CLEAR, the next graph corrects the named findings and reviews them in the same graph.

`.session/tasks.json` passed the direct Python field and heading check. `journal/working-memory.md` has been rewritten with all four sections.

## Discoveries
- `verify_method.py` may pin `verification.json` itself. That would make the R13b record circular, so ufg-0226 has to run the verifier again after re-pinning and record the final run (judgement; source: `.session/tasks.json` ufg-0226 Goal).
- #964 noted that preparation.json does not register current-pins.json, input-pins.json and some review files. This is carried as low (#964 report, Discoveries).
